email.subject: Velvet Works: a couple of quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Ivy,

I checked Velvet Works Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you clients: it isn't mobile-friendly, so anyone searching on their phone (most people) struggles to even load it, and there's no online booking, so people who want to book outside business hours just move on to a salon where they can.

The site also has no reviews shown, no listed hours, and a page title that doesn't say "hair salon in Harbor Falls," which hurts how you show up in search.

Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough and show you exactly what I mean, no obligation.

Alex
Northlight Web
